source: NCERT Class XI, An Introduction to Indian Art (Part 1), Ch. 2 (Arts of the Indus Valley).

sections.heading: 1. The Indus (Harappan) Civilisation — Art Overview
points: The **Indus Valley (Harappan) Civilisation** (c. 2500 BCE) produced remarkable art in **stone, bronze, terracotta and seals**.
Major sites: **Harappa, Mohenjodaro, Lothal, Dholavira, Rakhigarhi**.
Art shows a high level of skill, urban planning and craftsmanship.

sections.heading: 2. Sculpture — Stone and Bronze
points: **Bearded Priest-King** (steatite, Mohenjodaro) — a famous stone bust with a trefoil-patterned shawl, half-closed eyes.
**Male torso** (red sandstone, Harappa) — shows fine modelling.
**'Dancing Girl'** (Mohenjodaro) — a famous **bronze** figure made by the **lost-wax (cire perdue) technique**; shows confidence and grace.
Bronze casting by lost-wax method was well developed.

sections.heading: 3. Terracotta and Pottery
points: **Terracotta figures** — **Mother Goddess**, toys, animals, carts (cruder than bronze/stone).
**Pottery** — plain and painted (red-and-black ware) with designs of trees, birds, animals, geometric patterns.
Terracotta was widely used for daily and ritual objects.

sections.heading: 4. Seals, Beads and Ornaments
points: **Seals** — mostly of **steatite**; the famous **Pashupati seal** (a figure surrounded by animals) and the **unicorn/bull seals**; carry the undeciphered **Indus script** and animal motifs.
Seals were used for **trade and identification**.
**Bead-making and jewellery** (of gold, carnelian, faience) were highly advanced (e.g. at **Lothal, Chanhudaro**).

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Dancing Girl (Mohenjodaro) = bronze, made by lost-wax (cire perdue) technique.
Bearded Priest-King = steatite bust (Mohenjodaro), trefoil shawl.
Male torso = red sandstone (Harappa).
Seals mostly of steatite; Pashupati seal; carry the undeciphered Indus script.
Bead-making centres = Lothal, Chanhudaro; Mother Goddess = terracotta.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **Dancing Girl** is made of **bronze** (lost-wax method), from **Mohenjodaro**.
The **Priest-King** bust is of **steatite** (not bronze).
Harappan **seals** are mostly **steatite** and carry the **undeciphered** Indus script.
The **Pashupati seal** shows a figure surrounded by animals.
